statements.statement: The service billed was mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229)
The denial reason code was PR-204
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has intermittent symptoms requiring correlation of clinical events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to provide continuous rhythm monitoring and event correlation
The service was denied under PR-204 as not covered under the member's current benefit plan
